title: Guaranty Agreement
description: Guaranty Agreement contract normalized from the DocuBricks Financial services library.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Document
metadata:
  name: docubricks-fs-guaranty-agreement
  title: Guaranty Agreement
  description: Guaranty Agreement contract normalized from the DocuBricks Financial services library.
  version: fs_guaranty_agreement_v1
  source:
    system: docubricks
    sourceId: fs/guaranty_agreement
    sourcePath: Schemas/fs/guaranty_agreement
    sourceVersion: fs_guaranty_agreement_v1
    sourceDigest: 4d6176c9c5de5cc93543bdcf87851e16d00a727d8a6f8eca1ac084ccc2abf53e
spec:
  documentType: guaranty_agreement
  sections:
    - id: dates-and-terms
      title: Dates And Terms
      description: Dates And Terms fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - agreement-date
        - termination-rights
    - id: document-details
      title: Document Details
      description: Document Details fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - continuing-guaranty
        - governing-law
        - guaranteed-obligations
        - guarantor-type
        - guaranty-type
        - joint-and-several
        - signature-title
        - underlying-agreement-reference
        - waivers
    - id: financials
      title: Financials
      description: Financials fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - maximum-liability-amount
        - payment-on-demand
    - id: parties
      title: Parties
      description: Parties fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - borrower-name
        - guarantor-name
        - lender-name
        - signature-name
  fields:
    - id: agreement-date
      name: agreement_date
      label: Agreement Date
      description: Date of guaranty.
      dataType: date
      sourcePath: /fields/agreement_date
    - id: guarantor-name
      name: guarantor_name
      label: Guarantor Name
      description: Guarantor legal name.
      dataType: string
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/guarantor_name
    - id: guarantor-type
      name: guarantor_type
      label: Guarantor Type
      description: Individual, entity, trust, spouse, affiliate, or other.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/guarantor_type
    - id: borrower-name
      name: borrower_name
      label: Borrower Name
      description: Borrower whose obligations are guaranteed.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/borrower_name
    - id: lender-name
      name: lender_name
      label: Lender Name
      description: Lender or beneficiary.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/lender_name
    - id: underlying-agreement-reference
      name: underlying_agreement_reference
      label: Underlying Agreement Reference
      description: Loan agreement or note referenced.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/underlying_agreement_reference
    - id: guaranty-type
      name: guaranty_type
      label: Guaranty Type
      description: Unlimited, limited, payment, collection, completion, carve-out, springing, or other.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/guaranty_type
    - id: guaranteed-obligations
      name: guaranteed_obligations
      label: Guaranteed Obligations
      description: Description of obligations guaranteed.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/guaranteed_obligations
    - id: maximum-liability-amount
      name: maximum_liability_amount
      label: Maximum Liability Amount
      description: Cap or maximum amount if stated.
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /fields/maximum_liability_amount
    - id: continuing-guaranty
      name: continuing_guaranty
      label: Continuing Guaranty
      description: Whether guaranty is continuing.
      dataType: boolean
      sourcePath: /fields/continuing_guaranty
    - id: joint-and-several
      name: joint_and_several
      label: Joint And Several
      description: Whether liability is joint and several.
      dataType: boolean
      sourcePath: /fields/joint_and_several
    - id: payment-on-demand
      name: payment_on_demand
      label: Payment On Demand
      description: Whether payment is due on demand.
      dataType: boolean
      sourcePath: /fields/payment_on_demand
    - id: waivers
      name: waivers
      label: Waivers
      description: Waivers of notice, presentment, defenses, subrogation, jury trial, etc.
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /fields/waivers
    - id: termination-rights
      name: termination_rights
      label: Termination Rights
      description: Termination or revocation language.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/termination_rights
    - id: governing-law
      name: governing_law
      label: Governing Law
      description: Governing law jurisdiction.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/governing_law
    - id: signature-name
      name: signature_name
      label: Signature Name
      description: Signer name.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/signature_name
    - id: signature-title
      name: signature_title
      label: Signature Title
      description: Signer title if entity guarantor.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/signature_title
  validationRules:
    - id: guarantor-name-present
      severity: error
      description: Guaranty agreement must identify the guarantor.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: guarantor_name
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: guarantor_name
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: guarantor_name IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(guarantor_name)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: borrower-name-present
      severity: warning
      description: Borrower should be captured to link guaranty to the obligation.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: borrower_name
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: borrower_name
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: borrower_name IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(borrower_name)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: maximum-liability-positive
      severity: warning
      description: Liability cap must be positive when present.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: maximum_liability_amount
          - op: gt
            left:
              field: maximum_liability_amount
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: maximum_liability_amount IS NULL OR maximum_liability_amount > 0
      supported: true
    - id: waivers-array-valid
      severity: warning
      description: Waivers should be represented as an array.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: waivers
          - op: gte
            left:
              length: waivers
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: waivers IS NULL OR JSON_ARRAY_LENGTH(waivers) >= 0
      supported: true
    - id: governing-law-present
      severity: warning
      description: Governing law should be captured for enforceability review.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: governing_law
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: governing_law
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: governing_law IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(governing_law)) > 0
      supported: true
  reviewPolicy:
    unsupportedRuleAction: human-review
    defaultConfidenceThreshold: 0.75
    fieldConfidence:
      guarantor_name:
        minConfidence: 0.94
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Guarantor identity anchors credit support.
      borrower_name:
        minConfidence: 0.92
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Borrower links guaranty to the loan obligation.
      guaranty_type:
        minConfidence: 0.86
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Guaranty type affects enforcement and exposure analysis.
      maximum_liability_amount:
        minConfidence: 0.93
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Liability cap materially limits credit support.
      continuing_guaranty:
        minConfidence: 0.84
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Continuing status affects future advances.
  modelRouting:
    primary: databricks-claude-sonnet
    fallbackChain:
      - databricks-meta-llama-3-70b-instruct
    maxTokens: 4096
    temperature: 0
    timeoutSeconds: 30
    maxRetries: 2
    tierOverrides: {}
    rationale: Guaranty agreements require legal-term extraction around scope, limits, waivers, and continuing
      obligations.
  outputSchema:
    type: object
    properties:
      agreement_date:
        type: date
        description: Date of guaranty.
        format: date
      guarantor_name:
        type: string
        description: Guarantor legal name.
      guarantor_type:
        type: string
        description: Individual, entity, trust, spouse, affiliate, or other.
      borrower_name:
        type: string
        description: Borrower whose obligations are guaranteed.
      lender_name:
        type: string
        description: Lender or beneficiary.
      underlying_agreement_reference:
        type: string
        description: Loan agreement or note referenced.
      guaranty_type:
        type: string
        description: Unlimited, limited, payment, collection, completion, carve-out, springing, or other.
      guaranteed_obligations:
        type: string
        description: Description of obligations guaranteed.
      maximum_liability_amount:
        type: number
        description: Cap or maximum amount if stated.
      continuing_guaranty:
        type: boolean
        description: Whether guaranty is continuing.
      joint_and_several:
        type: boolean
        description: Whether liability is joint and several.
      payment_on_demand:
        type: boolean
        description: Whether payment is due on demand.
      waivers:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Waivers of notice, presentment, defenses, subrogation, jury trial, etc.
      termination_rights:
        type: string
        description: Termination or revocation language.
      governing_law:
        type: string
        description: Governing law jurisdiction.
      signature_name:
        type: string
        description: Signer name.
      signature_title:
        type: string
        description: Signer title if entity guarantor.
    required:
      - guarantor_name
    additionalProperties: false
  inertSourceMetadata:
    family: commercial_lending
    outputContract:
      fields_object: extracted_fields
      confidence_object: confidence
      metadata_object: extraction_metadata
    completenessChecklist:
      - id: required_fields_present
        description: All required fields are present or explicitly null with low confidence when absent.
        fields:
          - guarantor_name
      - id: section_coverage_reviewed
        description: Each declared section was reviewed for extractable evidence.
        sections:
          - dates_and_terms
          - document_details
          - financials
          - parties
      - id: nested_lists_normalized
        description: Object array fields use their item_schema for consistent nested extraction.
        fields: []
    sourceFiles:
      - fields.json
      - validation_rules.json
      - field_thresholds.json
      - model_routing.json
